draftExposure: Two draft report labels accidentally exposed; independently replaced, draft preserved. Final queries/identities not inspected before this policy freeze.

collection.history: one fresh product process per game per recovery arm, actual index retained across query sequence; beforeCount and publication history recorded

representations.V3: jevValueFlowRequest exact code: method context, machine roles, exact0/1 assignments, construction-only context warning
representations.S: V3 plus jevSemanticRoute unique-local-accessor preservation and context-equivalence veto; no confidence threshold
representations.J: optional release-function object/pick agreement retrieval plus V3; record separately from default S

bestDeterministicComparator: R1 binary method/return role scoring with modern deterministic query recovery, frozen source above
defaultScope: S member preference only, partial interactive query, existing branded anonymous C++ members with runtime evidence, strong/exact/named/ObjC unchanged; optional J retrieval not default-authorized by S results

decisions.DEFAULT_ON: V3 >=2 net rescues over R1 independently in each game; gold lattice recall>=50%; zero regression in every repeat; no destructive instability/false strong/unsafe confident; >=15 baseline-correct preservation cases including>=5 real anonymous C++ weak; default member API p95<=1000ms; API error<=5%; fail-closed/platform/canonical gates green
decisions.SELECTIVE_DEFAULT_ON: S >=1 net rescue over R1 independently in each game; zero regression in every repeat; same preservation/unsafe/strong/instability/latency/error/gate bars; only exact pre-frozen S route. Report candidate and semantic coverage without claiming broad availability. J retrieval gain cannot substitute for S gain.
decisions.OPTIONAL_ADVISORY: At least1 V3 or J improvement over R1 overall with main result preserved; no default activation
decisions.NO_GO: otherwise no remote production preference; deterministic improvements may ship
